comment: Deliberately narrow. This exists for one job: stop raw colour values being written outside the token files. It intentionally does NOT extend a standard config — those bring ~180 formatting opinions (rgba vs rgb, hex casing, blank lines) that would bury the signal and start an argument nobody asked for.

color-no-hex.message: Raw hex — use a design token from colors.scss / themes.scss instead (e.g. var(--primary-text), var(--accent-red)).

color-named.message: Named colour — use a design token from colors.scss / themes.scss instead.
